key: O Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture, but the raiment of restraint from evil, that is best.
s: After Adam and his wife leave the Garden, their shame laid bare, the surah turns to his children; al-Tabari, on 7:26, reads the ‘raiment of restraint’ as the fear of God worn next to the soul, gathering faith, good works, modesty and awe.

evidence.words: وأولى الأقوال بالصحة في تأويل قوله:"ولباس التقوى"، استشعار النفوس تقوى الله، في الانتهاء عما نهى الله عنه من معاصيه، والعمل بما أمر به من طاعته، وذلك يجمع الإيمان، والعمل الصالح، والحياء، وخشية الله، والسمتَ الحسن
evidence.gloss: The soundest of the views on the meaning of His words “the raiment of piety” is the souls’ taking the fear of God as their inner garment, in refraining from the acts of disobedience God has forbidden and in doing the obedience He has commanded; and that gathers faith, good works, modesty, awe of God and a good bearing.
